patterns_discovered.description: All views follow consistent create/read/update/delete patterns with explicit status transitions (DRAFT → PENDING → APPROVED/REJECTED)
patterns_discovered.impact: Maintains consistent business logic flow across all request operations

patterns_discovered.description: All POST endpoints return structured JSON responses with success/failure status and messages
patterns_discovered.impact: Enables client-side JavaScript handling of responses

patterns_discovered.description: List and detail views use select_related() for foreign keys and prefetch_related() for reverse relationships
patterns_discovered.impact: Reduces N+1 query problems in database access

patterns_discovered.description: Views delegate authorization to model properties (can_edit, can_approve) rather than checking directly
patterns_discovered.impact: Centralizes business logic validation in models

patterns_discovered.description: All POST endpoints wrap operations in try-catch to provide user-friendly error messages
patterns_discovered.impact: Prevents unhandled exceptions from reaching clients

patterns_discovered.description: All operations track created_by, updated_by, and timestamp fields
patterns_discovered.impact: Enables full audit logging of request lifecycle

patterns_discovered.description: request_list uses Q objects for multi-field search across reference_number, requester, and justification
patterns_discovered.impact: Flexible search capabilities without complex conditional logic

gotchas_discovered.description: Uses Decimal(str(quantity)) and Decimal(str(estimated_unit_price)) conversions instead of direct assignment
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicit conversion prevents floating-point precision issues with currency values

gotchas_discovered.description: Uses json.loads(request.body) but does not handle potential JSON decode errors
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Should wrap json.loads() in try-catch or use safer JSON handling

gotchas_discovered.description: request_update conditionally updates warehouse but never validates warehouse_id presence separately
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Allows partial updates but could silently skip warehouse changes if not provided

gotchas_discovered.description: request_list performs 4 separate COUNT queries for stats instead of single aggregation query
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Could use annotate() with conditional aggregation to reduce database queries

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No Pagination for Stats Context Data
gotchas_discovered.description: Warehouse and Material querysets are unfiltered in request_list context, could be large
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Should paginate or limit materials/warehouses dropdown data

gotchas_discovered.description: request_submit changes status but does not set submission_date or similar tracking field
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Should track when request enters PENDING state for audit purposes

key_achievements: Complete purchase request lifecycle management (create, list, detail, update, submit, approve, reject)
Item management within requests (add and remove)
Status workflow enforcement with state machine pattern
Consistent error handling and user feedback
approach_outcome.notes: File successfully creates a feature-complete purchase request management module with proper workflow state management and error handling.

recommendations.details: Replace 4 separate COUNT queries with single annotate() query using conditional aggregation
recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce database queries from 4 to 1 on list view

recommendations.recommendation: Add try-catch for JSON parsing in request_reject
recommendations.details: Wrap json.loads(request.body) to handle malformed JSON gracefully
recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevent 400 errors from invalid request bodies

recommendations.details: Track when request enters PENDING state in request_submit view
recommendations.estimated_impact: Enable audit reporting on submission timeline

recommendations.details: Limit materials and warehouses in context data to prevent large dataset rendering
recommendations.estimated_impact: Improve frontend performance with large material/warehouse counts

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit warehouse_id validation in request_update
recommendations.details: Separate warehouse_id existence check from conditional update logic
recommendations.estimated_impact: Clarify intent and prevent silent failures

recommendations.recommendation: Add comprehensive unit tests for all view functions
recommendations.details: Test status transitions, permission checks, item add/remove, error cases
recommendations.estimated_impact: Ensure reliability and maintainability of purchase request workflow
